title: HydroGym Phase 1 tasks: a playbook-keyed benchmark of hydrology agents on real sites (60 tasks, seed 2026)
description: Sixty benchmark tasks for hydrology agents, generated by aquascope gym tasks --n 60 --seed 2026 (aquascope 0.13, branch feat/solve) from the three method-selection playbooks of AquaScope (flood risk, ungauged flow, groundwater decline) on 15 real sites drawn from the AquaScope station catalog: gauges of the U.S. Geological Survey, the Environment Agency (England) and Hub'Eau (France), Environment Agency observation boreholes, and bare points near measured rivers. Each task is a problem in plain language at a place, the playbook's intake, a snapshot of the data reconnaissance at that place (the catalog gauges within 50 km with their record spans, the BasinATLAS catchment attributes, the donor count, the method sufficiency table) and the scoring key: the branch, gates and tools the playbook's decision tree selects on that snapshot, or its decline sentence when the right answer is to refuse (15 tasks are unsolvable by construction, all 15 of them intake probes of the playbooks' own decline rules). Sites are split into train and test by a deterministic hash (6 sites, 24 tasks held out). The key measures agreement with the playbooks, not hydrological truth. The README describes the task format, the scoring, the split and the licences of the underlying catalogs. Results of the first runs (a keyless plan-first team, Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Haiku 4.5 on the team, Claude Sonnet 5 on a plain tool loop) are in the AquaScope repository under aquascope/gym/results/2026-09-03/.
notes: Generated with aquascope (https://github.com/Rekin226/aquascope), issue #175 (HydroGym), Phase 1. Recon snapshots carry catalog-level station metadata (identifiers, names, positions, record spans) from USGS (public domain), Environment Agency (OGL-UK-3.0) and Hub'Eau / Eaufrance (Licence Ouverte / Etalab 2.0), and catchment attributes from BasinATLAS, HydroATLAS v1.0 (CC BY 4.0, Linke et al. 2019). No observation record is included.
